hints.label: nudge
hints.text: Exit code 137 is 128 + 9: the process was killed with SIGKILL, and nobody in your code sent it. Ask who has the authority to do that to a container.

hints.label: pointer to the signal
hints.text: Run the job, then `docker inspect <container> --format '{{.State.OOMKilled}} {{.State.ExitCode}} {{.HostConfig.Memory}}'`. Compare the memory limit to how much memory report.py holds at once (it builds a list of every chunk before it hashes).

hints.label: near-solution
hints.text: Either stream the data (hash each chunk and drop it, so the working set is one chunk) or raise mem_limit above the real working set plus headroom (memswap_limit must be raised with it). Keep a limit: removing it, setting it to gigabytes or disabling the OOM killer are not fixes.
